title: Claude ACTUALLY got dumber...
description:
Could Mythos not have fixed this?...
#developer #aidevelopment #claude #claudecode #programming
transcript: Claude definitely got dumber. Anthropic just admitted this, publishing a postmortem explaining why Claude code was worse over the last month, and it comes down to three main reasons. First, they changed the default reasoning effort from high to medium to reduce the latency, so it was faster, but it was less capable of those harder coding tasks. The second issue was a bug that caused Claude to drop its old reasoning every single message after an idle session, and that's why it felt forgetful and repetitive. And the third and final factor is they actually changed the system prompt in Claude code to try and reduce its verbosity, but this actually impacted code quality, so much so they actually had to revert this. So, it wasn't actually Claude the model that got dumber, it was the harness, Claude code, and it's kind of insane to me that they don't test these things before pushing out these changes.
